home.title: Raba fayiloli tsakanin dandamali cikin sauƙi
home.subtitle: dropX yana aika hotuna, bidiyo, waƙoƙi, takardu da manhajoji kai tsaye tsakanin na'urorinku ta hanyar Wi-Fi na gida ko hotspot na na'ura. Babu waya, babu gajimare, babu haɗin intanet.
feature.cross_platform.title: Tsakanin dandamali
feature.cross_platform.body: Android, iOS, Windows, macOS da Linux duk suna haɗuwa da juna.
feature.no_internet.title: Ba a buƙatar Intanet
feature.no_internet.body: Aikawa tana tsayawa a cikin hanyar sadarwarka ta gida. Ba a amfani da data ta waya.
feature.private.title: Na sirri kuma kai tsaye
feature.private.body: Fayiloli suna tafiya daga na'ura zuwa na'ura. Ba a loda komai zuwa sabar.
feature.any_file.title: Kowane irin fayil
feature.any_file.body: Hotuna, bidiyo, waƙoƙi, takardu da manhajojin Android (APK).
feature.hotspot.title: Wi-Fi ko Hotspot
feature.hotspot.body: Yi amfani da rauta, ko haɗa na'urori biyu kai tsaye da hotspot.
feature.verified.title: Aikawa da aka tabbatar
feature.verified.body: Ana duba kowane sashe domin abin da ya iso ya yi daidai da abin da aka aika.
feature.auth.title: Tabbatar da Na'ura
feature.auth.body: Allon biyu suna nuna gajeren lambar tabbatarwa. Idan sun yi daidai, babu wanda ke saurare a tsakiya — kuma kowane aikawa yana buƙatar amincewar mai karɓa tukuna.
feature.chunks.title: Babu Sashen da Aka Bari a Baya
feature.chunks.body: Ana tabbatar da kowane sashe da zarar ya isa, kuma ana duba kowane fayil da ya kammala, don haka aikawa tana kammaluwa ne kawai idan an tabbatar da kowane byte.
